title: Floating controls over straw, right hand
about: Floating controls (no dock band): the dry farm's straw runs to the bottom edge behind Action, Interact (the bin is in reach, so it shows), Menu and the hotbar's slot plates. A full hotbar: tools, seeds selected (the gold ring and the 4 px lip), gold-star cauliflower and a stack of eggs. Check every plate is solid (no see-through pixel), the 2 px outlines and lips read on straw, a tap on the straw between the controls walks there, and the farmer stays above the controls. Open on the iPhone 13 (390x844) and the SE (375x667, ui-float-controls-se).
